purpose: Form INC-34 is used as the e-Articles of Association along with SPICe+ for the incorporation of a company.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the application for incorporation using SPICe+.
Attach e-Articles of Association in Form No. INC-34.
File the application with the Registrar within whose jurisdiction the registered office is proposed to be situated.
checklist: Ensure e-Articles of Association in Form No. INC-34 is ready for attachment.
Check if the company falls under section 8 or has specific subscriber conditions that require different forms instead of INC-34.
Prepare the fee of rupees five hundred in addition to the registration fee.
attachments: e-Memorandum of Association (e-MOA) in Form No. INC-33
watch: Ensure the correct form is used, as certain companies with more than seven subscribers or foreign signatories follow different formats.
